=== Notes ===
* Draven88 is written as Kevin Reitzel: he signs "Kevin, Atlanta, GA", owns one of the two cubes, and "Kevin Reitzel" is the only Kevin in his results list; Murray's captions say "Kevin and his cube".
* Games column: as posted (F/T = full or timed, W/L = win or loss, followed by the points).
* Murray's caption calls the 10th-place player "Jordan (Kyle) Windham"; the table follows the results list. "Chris (forgot his last name)" in the captions is presumably Chris Castagnetto.
=== Missing data ===
* Regional winner and full standings; Mini-Open winner. The Regional's two bids went to Jeremy DiPaolo and Travis Cooper (2nd), so the winner may already have held a bye; not stated.

* The report links photobucket images (Throdo's album); not linked in the article.
